info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Document Archiving Management API
info.description: The Document Archiving Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently update the archiving status of specific banking documents. This API facilitates the PATCH operation, allowing users to modify existing document records seamlessly within the archiving system. Typical consumers include banking professionals and document management systems that require timely updates to maintain compliance and improve operational efficiency. Effective document handling is crucial for legal compliance and streamlined information retrieval, making this API an essential tool in the banking sector.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specific document archive service identified by its unique resource ID. Ensure that the request payload contains the necessary fields that need to be updated.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the document with the specified ID in the archive services. It allows for modifying certain fields of the document while preserving the existing structure. Please ensure that the appropriate values are provided according to the schema to successfully perform the update.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning updated document details.
